title: Fixed Deployed Three Section Attic Ladder
description: One original complete fixed-deployed attic access ladder appearance. A thick horizontal ceiling curb has a real through-opening. Its lowered whole hatch panel lies behind the first of three distinct ladder sections; explicit section hinge plates and cross pins join the six full rails, with nine whole horizontal treads, two grounded shoes, top hinge bearings and paired fixed two-link side limiters connected to the curb. All geometry newly authored, no old A-frame, wheeled library ladder or vertical airlock model reused. Three opaque constant PBR materials, metre game units, Z-up, horizontally centred ground origin. One static prop, zero scenes, no surrounding ceiling or host building. The ceiling curb is an intentionally unsupported mounting interface without a supplied host. No folding motion, mechanism clearance, locking, climbing, accessibility, load, fit, installation, manufacture or building safety capability is claimed.
